If you truly believe communism is the better system, by all means, go live under it.

Stop trying to turn 🇺🇸 into the kind of country millions have risked everything to escape.

Billions around the world dream of the opportunities 🇺🇸 offers.

There’s a reason it’s called the American Dream.
